entries.title: Leviticus 24:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

entries.title: Leviticus 24:2
segments: "Command the children of Israel that they bring to you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to make the lamps burn continually.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:3
segments: "Outside the veil of the Testimony, in the tabernacle of meeting, Aaron shall be in charge of it from evening until morning before the LORD continually; [it shall be] a statute forever in your generations.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:4
segments: "He shall be in charge of the lamps on the pure [gold] lampstand before the LORD continually.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:5
segments: "And you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes with it. Two-tenths [of an ephah] shall be in each cake.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:6
segments: "You shall set them in two rows, six in a row, on the pure [gold] table before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:7
segments: "And you shall put pure frankincense on [each] row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:8
segments: "Every Sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, [being taken] from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:9
segments: "And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it [is] most holy to him from the offerings of the LORD made by fire, by a perpetual statute."

entries.title: Leviticus 24:10
segments: ¶Now the son of an Israelite woman, whose father [was] an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and this Israelite [woman's] son and a man of Israel fought each other in the camp.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:11
segments: And the Israelite woman's son blasphemed the name [of the LORD] and cursed; and so they brought him to Moses. (His mother's name [was] Shelomith the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)

entries.title: Leviticus 24:12
segments: Then they put him in custody, that the mind of the LORD might be shown to them.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:13
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 24:14
segments: "Take outside the camp him who has cursed; then let all who heard [him] lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:15
segments: "Then you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:16
segments: 'And whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him, the stranger as well as him who is born in the land. When he blasphemes the name [of the LORD], he shall be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:17
segments: 'Whoever kills any man shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:18
segments: 'Whoever kills an animal shall make it good, animal for animal.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:19
segments: 'If a man causes disfigurement of his neighbor, as he has done, so shall it be done to him-

entries.title: Leviticus 24:20
segments: 'fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has caused disfigurement of a man, so shall it be done to him.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:21
segments: 'And whoever kills an animal shall restore it; but whoever kills a man shall be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:22
segments: 'You shall have the same law for the stranger and for one from your own country; for I [am] the LORD your God.'"

entries.title: Leviticus 24:23
segments: Then Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they took outside the camp him who had cursed, and stoned him with stones. So the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
